performance.verdict: Paid channels dark for 28 days; only organic GBP shows any signal.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day window — $0 spent, 0 leads, 0 CPL calculable. Paid engine is completely off.
8 SOW milestones overdue (earliest Jul 20): GHL build gaps, Becklar/BWS money-path verification, Offline Conversion Import, CAPI, landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete.
GBP call rate is 0 across 104 impressions and 25 days of visibility — call button is broken or call tracking is misconfigured; 64 directions logged but zero calls recorded.
GA4 sessions trending down in the 3-day signal: Oct 24–26 average 15 sessions/day vs Oct 21–23 average 18.7 — a -20% softening with no paid traffic to explain a reversal.
GHL shows 5 contacts and 2 opportunities but 0 appointments and 0 won — pipeline intake appears functional but stalled at nurture; no paid source to reconcile volume against.

suggestions.text: Fix GBP call button or call-tracking config — 0 calls from 104 impressions confirms a broken conversion path.
suggestions.monday_update: The Liferun GBP profile recorded 0 calls against 104 impressions and 25 days of visibility over 28 days — call rate is confirmed zero. Audit the GBP listing call button, forwarding number, and any call-tracking layer (e.g. CallRail or GHL number) to identify the break. Success is confirmed when at least 1 tracked call appears in the GBP dashboard within 7 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-11-03.

suggestions.text: Resolve all 8 overdue SOW milestones — Becklar/BWS money paths and CAPI are ⛔ scale blockers before any paid relaunch.
